jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Responsible for leading all aspects of distribution center operations, including customer service, inventory management, financial performance, operational efficiency, safety, and team member development. Oversees daily warehouse and transportation activities to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective service to stores while maintaining compliance with O’Reilly policies and operational standards. Provides strategic leadership to drive productivity, continuous improvement, accountability, and a high-performance culture throughout the distribution center.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
- Oversee all aspects of distribution center operations, including transportation, shipping, receiving, inventory control, warehouse operations, customer service, physical assets, and inventory integrity.
- Lead daily operational performance to ensure on-time deliveries, shipment accuracy, efficient materials movement, and excellent service levels to stores and customers.
- Direct and manage all distribution center expenses, including labor, operating costs, and capital expenditures, while maintaining alignment with financial objectives and budget expectations.
- Partner with the Regional Director Distribution to develop annual business plans, operational strategies, labor plans, and capital budgets that support company goals.
- Collaborate closely with Human Resources to support recruiting, retention, engagement, corrective action processes, and overall team member relations initiatives when needed.
- Conduct team member evaluations, coaching discussions, development planning, and bench building to support succession planning initiatives.
- Promote and maintain a safe working environment by aggressively managing risk, loss prevention, workplace safety initiatives, and environmental standards.
- Analyze operational metrics, workflow performance, labor utilization, transportation activity, and inventory trends to identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency improvements.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow optimization, warehouse layout efficiency, logistics processes, scheduling effectiveness, and overall supply chain performance.
- Support additional operational initiatives, special projects, and other duties as assigned by the Regional DC Director or senior leadership in support of distribution center objectives.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
Required:
- Minimum of 6 years of distribution center, logistics, warehouse, or supply chain experience.
- Minimum of 3 years of leadership or management experience within a distribution environment.
- Strong understanding of safety practices, risk management, key performance indicators and regulatory compliance within a distribution environment.
- Ability to develop and manage operational budgets, labor expenses, and capital planning initiatives.
- Experience leading large teams across multiple operational functions and shifts.

Desired:
- Experience utilizing warehouse management systems (WMS), transportation management systems (TMS), or supply chain analytics tools.
- Knowledge of advanced logistics planning and inventory optimization.

jobs.title: Manager Program Management- IT
jobs.description:
The Manager Program Management- IT will lead a team of project managers to successfully deliver IT projects. Collaborate with IT leaders to implement and continuously improve Iterative and Agile project management practices that improve project outcomes. Maintain responsibility and accountability for successful delivery of projects that meet organizational goals and deliver business value.

This is an on-site position located in Springfield, MO. Remote work is not an option for this role.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
- Lead a team of project managers to ensure successful delivery of IT projects to deliver business value across technology and business functions
- Develop a vision for improving the value created by the Program Management office by transforming and continuously improving services offered and implementing additional services that improve solution delivery
- Collaborate with solution delivery teams and leadership to implement, standardize and improve project management processes across the IT department
- Co-create and implement improvements and best practices that drive improved department outcomes (e.g., Agile, Lean, Dev Ops, etc.)
- Coach and advise project managers and teams on the best application, implementation and utilization of project management approaches such as Scrum, Kanban, Agile, Lean, and Iterative Waterfall within a fast-paced, high tech environment
- Coach project managers on how to improve soft-skills including facilitation, mediation, relationship-building, and improving team dynamics
- Support successful delivery of projects, programs and the portfolio by improving prioritization, estimation, planning, scheduling, slotting and resourcing of projects
- Maintain a broad knowledge of project management, solution delivery, quality assurance, hardware/infrastructure and IT operations practices such as Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe, DevOps, ITIL, etc.
- Manage project management personnel, including work allocation, training, and problem resolution; evaluate performance and make recommendations for personnel actions; motivate employees to achieve peak productivity and performance.
- Identify and utilize the appropriate tools and techniques to manage programs and projects with varied characteristics, focusing on results over processes
- Partner with IT and functional leadership to recover from impacts to projects and accommodate changing business needs.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE/ABILITIES
Required:
- Bachelor's degree in any field, or equivalent practical experience; a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline is a plus
- 3+ years of experience managing and developing a team in program management supporting technical programs.
- 5+ years of technical program or project management experience delivering cross-functional technology initiatives
- Experience delivering programs using multiple methodologies, including Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Waterfall/hybrid approaches
- Working knowledge of software application development concepts and the software development lifecycle
- Working knowledge of information technology concepts including networking, hardware, and infrastructure
- Familiarity with quality assurance concepts and practices, including testing and release management
- Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and stakeholder escalations across concurrent workstreams
- Experience driving engineering readiness, operational readiness, vendor coordination, and technical governance activities across complex technology programs
- Experience tracking program budgets and communicating financial impacts
- Proficiency with program management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences and present comfortably to large groups
- Strong facilitation, mediation, and relationship-building skills; proven ability to lead through influence using sound judgment, trustworthiness, and candor
- Advanced planning, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities in a dynamic, collaborative environment
- Proven track record of serving internal stakeholders and driving successful project outcomes

Desired:
- Experience in retail store operations, eCommerce, omnichannel, supply chain, infrastructure, data, or enterprise technology.
- Experience managing projects involving multiple Technology disciplines and significant cross-team dependencies.
- Experience with scaled delivery frameworks and practices such as SAFe, DevOps, and ITIL.
- Experience supporting organizational change, process improvement, or Technology transformation initiatives.
- PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent certification.
- Experience in the automotive aftermarket, auto parts, or retail industry.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Outbound
jobs.description:
Responsible for assisting the Distribution Center Manager in directing the day-to-day inbound and outbound operations of a single distribution center. Supports all operational areas including service, productivity, inventory integrity, team member development, budgeting, safety, and compliance. Provides leadership to supervisors and hourly team members while driving operational efficiency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the distribution center.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
- Assist the General Manager in overseeing daily inbound and outbound operations, including service levels, operational performance, inventory integrity, and team member productivity.
- Lead and support a staff of supervisors and hourly team members while promoting accountability, engagement, and operational excellence.
- Ensure compliance with O’Reilly policies, operational procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements throughout all distribution center functions.
- Monitor operational metrics and workflow performance to identify improvement opportunities.
- Coordinate staffing, labor planning, scheduling, and workload distribution to meet productivity and service objectives.
- Partner with supervisors to monitor departmental expenses, labor utilization, payroll, and operating costs while supporting budget objectives.
- Assist with the development and execution of annual operational goals, action plans, and performance initiatives for managed function.
- Support recruiting, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management activities when needed.
- Conduct timely performance evaluations and provide ongoing coaching and development to supervisors and hourly team members.
- Ensure inventory control processes, product handling procedures, shipping, receiving, and warehouse operations are executed accurately and efficiently.
- Review operational processes and recommend improvements to enhance workflow efficiency, service performance, and expense control.
- Maintain a safe work environment by aggressively managing risk, enforcing safety procedures, and addressing unsafe conditions or behaviors promptly.
- Utilize warehouse management systems and operational reporting to support planning operational execution.
- Communicate effectively with the General Manager, supervisors, and team members regarding operational priorities and expectations.
- Promote a culture based on O’Reilly culture values and continuous improvement throughout the distribution center.
- Perform additional duties as assigned.

SKILLS/EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE
Required:
- Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and team development skills.
- Experience leading supervisors and large hourly workforces.
- Ability to drive accountability, continuous improvement, and operational consistency across multiple functions.
- 2+ years of leadership experience in distribution center or warehouse operations with a proven record of success.

Desired:
- Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS), labor management systems, and operational analytics tools.
- Proficiency in one or more additional languages.
